name: model-router
description: Auto-select and execute the best signed-in model across Codex, OpenCode, and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Auto-route tasks across coding harness models.
interface.longDescription: Use bounded prompt, conversation, and repository context to choose a signed-in Codex, OpenCode, or Claude Code model and reasoning effort, preserve task affinity, and keep the current model as fallback.
defaultPrompt: Automatically choose the best signed-in model for this coding task.
Use conversation and repository context to route this bounded task.
Keep this task on the selected candidate.
